answer:
Verdict: cannot tell from this trace

## What the measurements show

Over the full trace (offsets 0–30,632.7 ms), watchdog (TID 641769) spent **0.0%** of its time in request or I/O calls; its long wait was a `clock_nanosleep` (30,024.8 ms).

The other filestore threads’ reported longest calls were also not storage I/O: writer’s was `clock_nanosleep` (5.868 ms), reader’s was `clock_nanosleep` (200.062 ms), the main thread’s was `futex` (30,001.4 ms), and stats’ was `clock_nanosleep` (1,000.193 ms). But the trace findings don’t give those threads’ **total time in storage-I/O calls**, so they don’t establish whether any reached the 25% threshold.
